body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.72 (naive base rate 0.70) that: Polycab India Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥13.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Oct-2026): revenue record (+53% YoY per screener: ₹9,899 cr), EBITDA margin 14.4% (+50 bps QoQ); W&C EBIT margin 14.2%; FMEG EBIT 10.1% (first double-digit), FMEG growth +124% (solar). Management keeps the W&C medium-term EBITDA guide at '11% to 13%' and flags 'near-term inflationary pressures… surfacing'. Screener OPM: Sep-24 11.5%, Dec-24 13.8%, Mar-25 14.7%, Jun-25 14.5%, Sep-25 15.8%, Dec-25 12.7%, Mar-26 13.1%, Jun-26 13.8%, Sep-26 14.4%. Reasoning: Management talks conservatively (11–13% guide) while delivering above it for most quarters — the mirror image of a hype gap. We side with delivery, shaded for copper/inflation and the Q3 FY26 dip to 12.7%. Resolution: YES if Polycab's consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026 (screener.in quarterly table, or EBITDA ÷ revenue from operations from the results) is ≥13.0%. Source: Polycab Q3 FY27 results (NSE) / screener.in consolidated quarterly table. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
